# Outline trial

Source: https://github.com/tonybfox/threejs-tools/tree/main/packages/outline
Author: Tony Fox. The upstream package declares MIT licensing.
OutlineTool source blob: 70fbc7dca2cf55d084498f5c63107d77e10a3dc0.
